preamble: The Middle Chinese voiced retroflex stop initial 澄 (*ɖ, Baxter dr-) became the voiceless aspirated retroflex affricate [ʈʂʰ] in Standard Mandarin in level-tone (平聲) syllables, following the general rule that Middle Chinese voiced obstruents devoiced to aspirates in the level tone and to unaspirated stops in the other tones (cf. d_retroflex_to_ch_retroflex for 柱 zhù, 重 zhòng). The change is confined to Mandarin-type varieties that keep a retroflex series.

examples.from: Middle Chinese 陳 drin 'to display; a surname' (level tone)

examples.note: All three have the 澄 initial and level tone, which regularly yields the aspirated affricate.
